rationale: This is the final iteration, so the design I submit is the one scored on the unseen track. The evidence favours the iteration 6 design, which is the best raced candidate (score 372.74, 19 of 20 oval finishes, oval max_error 0.042, line losses 0.25). Iteration 10 raced the approved proposal: outer sensors at x = ±0.040 m. It scored 267.93, with oval finishes down from 19 to 10 and s-bend and slalom still off track in every run. The Evaluator's rule was to keep ±0.040 m only if oval finishes stayed at 17 or more and the score held at or above 372.74. Neither condition holds, so I revert the outer sensors to x = ±0.032 m. Every other value is also restored to iteration 6: kp 3.0, kd 0.40, ki 0.30, base_speed 1.5, footprint 0.016 m, antisymmetric weights (-1.6, -0.8, 0, 0.8, 1.6), and line_loss last_direction. The earlier tests of kp 3.25, kd 0.50 and base_speed 1.3 all lowered the score, so I do not change them. This design has the most race evidence (60 trials). The expected result is about 19 of 20 oval finishes with a score near 370, although s-bend and slalom will probably still fail. The main uncertainty is generalisation to the unseen track, which I cannot measure from here. Measurements requested: per-track finish count, progress, max_error location, line-loss timing, steering_oscillation and oval completion_time.
